fullstack.headline: Software Engineer | Full-Stack
fullstack.summary: Software engineer with a B.Sc. in Computer Science and experience across the full software lifecycle: design, development, deploy, and production operations. I build scalable RESTful APIs, backend automations, and distributed services with messaging, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (GCP). I work with Python, C# (.NET), TypeScript, React, and SQL, with a solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and problem solving.

dotnet.headline: .NET Backend Developer | APIs & integrations
dotnet.summary: Backend developer focused on C# (.NET), versioned RESTful APIs, and secure integrations. Experience with SQL Server/PostgreSQL, Docker, CI/CD, and production operations. I deliver well-documented, testable services ready to scale.

python.headline: Python Developer | Automation & data
python.summary: Developer with strong Python experience for automation, integrations, and data pipelines. I work with BigQuery, SQL, and APIs — from prototype to production — prioritizing clear code, observability, and continuous delivery.

react.headline: Front-end Developer | React & TypeScript
react.summary: Front-end developer with React and TypeScript, including React Native. I build dynamic, responsive, product-oriented interfaces — from Figma to code — with attention to accessibility, performance, and API integration.

backend.headline: Backend Developer | APIs & distributed systems
backend.summary: Backend developer focused on APIs, microservices, messaging, and infrastructure. Experience with Docker, GCP, CI/CD, and relational/analytical databases. I design and operate reliable services from API contract to deploy.
